label: STUB DETECTOR RUN, NOT A MODEL EVALUATION
description: Harness code-complete proof: a deterministic synthetic fixture evaluated end to end through the real harness core (preprocess, matching, metrics, report writing) with a stub detector. Oracle metrics are exactly 1.0 and noop metrics are exactly 0.0. No model exists yet; these numbers validate the tooling only.

oracle.name: stub:oracle
oracle.note: returns each ground truth box with deterministic sub-threshold jitter

fixture.note: synthetic; generated deterministically, never used for training

method.preprocess: letterbox 640x640 pad 114 centered, RGB float32 NCHW, (v/255 - mean)/std ImageNet
method.nms: none (DETR-style set prediction, raw per-query outputs)
method.map_definition: single-class AP at IoU 0.5, VOC 2010+ all-point interpolation
method.matching: greedy highest-IoU, confidence descending, one GT claimed once

timing.note: stub timings measure harness overhead only, not model inference
